display.purpose: Hero wordmark and splash only; monumental, stacked, uppercase Syne 800.

title.purpose: Section and card headings; the label on a photo card.

body.purpose: All running copy, descriptions, form values; DM Sans.

label.purpose: Tracked Bebas eyebrows, field labels, badges, nav captions; often gold.

shadows.name: floating-nav
shadows.purpose: The one heavy drop shadow: lifts the glass bottom tab bar off the content.

shadows.name: gold-glow-active
shadows.purpose: Under the active gold tab and the Ti Roulé button.

shadows.name: gold-glow-hover
shadows.purpose: Blooms under primary buttons on hover, paired with a slight scale.

motion.name: ease-premium
motion.purpose: Default premium ease-out for logo, splash pops, and hover transforms.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Loading bar and neutral state transitions.

motion.name: logo-float
motion.purpose: Gentle idle float on the app-header logo.

motion.name: kenburns
motion.purpose: Cinematic slow zoom on hero imagery.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all of the above disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action on a view: solid gold, ink text, gold glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; background:#F5C842; color:#0a0a0a; font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1rem; padding:1rem 2.5rem; border:none; border-radius:9999px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s, transform .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#d4a800; transform:scale(1.04); box-shadow:0 10px 36px rgba(245,200,66,.4); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F5C842; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: transparent gold wash with a gold hairline, so it never competes with the one primary gold CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; background:rgba(245,200,66,.10); color:#F5C842; font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1rem; padding:1rem 2rem; border:1px solid rgba(245,200,66,.3); border-radius:9999px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:rgba(245,200,66,.15); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Field on ink-card with a solid hairline; the stroke itself lights up gold on focus. Bebas label with a gold required asterisk.
components.css: .ds-field { display:block; } .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:.5rem; font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif; font-size:.625rem; letter-spacing:.25em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#888; } .ds-field-label em { color:#F5C842; font-style:normal; } .ds-input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; background:#111; color:#F5F5F0; font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; padding:.875rem 1rem; border:1px solid #222; border-radius:.75rem; transition:border-color .2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:rgba(136,136,136,.5); } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#F5C842; outline:none; }

components.name: Photo Card
components.description: Signature portrait card: full-bleed island photo, bottom scrim, hairline border that warms to gold and lifts on hover.
components.html: POPULARScooters
components.css: .ds-card-photo { position:relative; display:block; aspect-ratio:4/5; width:11rem; overflow:hidden; border-radius:1rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); text-decoration:none; transition:transform .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-card-photo:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); border-color:rgba(245,200,66,.4); } .ds-card-photo:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(245,200,66,.5); } .ds-card-img { position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,200,66,.25), #0a0a0a); } .ds-card-scrim { position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(to top, rgba(10,10,10,.85), transparent 55%); } .ds-card-chip { position:absolute; top:.5rem; right:.5rem; background:#F5C842; color:#0a0a0a; font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif; font-size:.5rem; letter-spacing:.12em; padding:.15rem .5rem; border-radius:9999px; } .ds-card-title { position:absolute; left:.75rem; bottom:.75rem; color:#F5F5F0; font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.125rem; }

components.name: Floating Bottom Nav
components.description: Signature app chrome: a frosted glass pill floating above the content. Active tab gets a solid gold pill; the center Ti Roulé button is always gold with a glow.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.25rem; background:rgba(10,10,10,.8); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-radius:1rem; padding:.375rem; box-shadow:0 16px 44px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.75); } .ds-nav svg { width:20px; height:20px; stroke:currentColor; fill:none; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-nav-item { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:.25rem; min-width:52px; padding:.375rem .5rem; border-radius:.75rem; color:#888; background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav-item span { font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif; font-size:10px; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color:#F5F5F0; } .ds-nav-item.active { color:#0a0a0a; background:linear-gradient(#F5C842,#d4a800); box-shadow:0 4px 14px -3px rgba(245,200,66,.55); } .ds-nav-ti { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:.25rem; min-width:52px; padding:.375rem .5rem; border-radius:1rem; color:#0a0a0a; background:linear-gradient(#F5C842,#d4a800); border:none; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 6px 18px -4px rgba(245,200,66,.55); } .ds-nav-ti span { font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif; font-size:10px; font-weight:500; }

narrative.overview: The interface is the last hour of island daylight rendered as software: a deep, near-black canvas lit by warm marigold gold. It is app-first, not brochure-first: the primary scene is a traveler holding a phone, so every surface behaves like a native app the moment it loads. Warmth carries the emotion — golden glows, a slow Ken Burns drift on hero imagery, an ember-orange bloom low in the frame — while structure keeps it trustworthy enough to take a payment. Density is calm and generous: full-bleed photography, one clear action per view, hairline-bordered cards floating on ink. Gold is never decoration; it is wayfinding — it marks the next action, the active tab, the required field, the price that matters. Because the canvas is so dark, a single gold element reads as light in a room.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas (#0a0a0a) with warm marigold gold (#F5C842) as the only true accent.
App-first: floating glass bottom nav, PWA splash, native-feeling motion — never a static webpage.
Full-bleed island photography inside hairline-bordered, gently-rounded cards.
Gold is structural wayfinding, not decoration.
Three-typeface system: geometric display (Syne), humanist body (DM Sans), condensed tracked labels (Bebas Neue).
60fps transform/opacity/filter motion, fully disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Gold-Is-Information Rule
rules.body: Gold is structural, never ornamental. If a gold element is not the next action, the active state, a required marker, or the price that matters, it is wrong — recolor it offwhite or muted. A screen should have exactly one primary-gold call to action.

rules.name: The Warm-Black Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are warm near-black (#0a0a0a), text is warm off-white (#F5F5F0). Never pure #000 or pure #fff — the whole world sits at golden hour, and clinical black-on-white breaks the spell.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Syne for display/headings, DM Sans for body, Bebas for tracked labels — never substitute one for another's job. A body paragraph in Syne or a heading in Bebas is a system violation.

rules.name: The Whole-Word Rule
rules.body: Headings never hyphenate or break a word across lines (word-break: keep-all; hyphens: none). On small phones, whole words stay intact — readability outranks a tidy right edge.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with a hairline of light (border-white/10) and a top-lit gradient, not a drop shadow. Shadows appear only under the floating nav and as a gold glow on the active/primary element.

dos: Do keep exactly one primary-gold action per view; everything else is offwhite, muted, or ghost. Gold marks the next step (the Gold-Is-Information Rule).
Do separate surfaces with a hairline of light (border-white/10) and a top-lit gradient — not a drop shadow (the Light-Not-Shadow Rule).
Do use warm near-black (#0a0a0a) and warm off-white (#F5F5F0), never pure black or white.
Do assign type by voice: Syne for display/headings, DM Sans for body, Bebas for tracked labels — and keep each in its tier.
Do lead with full-bleed island photography inside rounded-2xl hairline cards; overlay text on a bottom scrim.
Do author motion with transform/opacity/filter only, and disable it under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do warm borders toward gold on hover (hover:border-yellow/40) and lift cards -translate-y-0.5.
Do reserve bottom padding (pb-[116px]) so content never hides under the floating tab bar.
donts: Don't use gold as decoration, large fills, or on more than the one primary action — its scarcity is what makes it read as premium.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent. Ember (#f97316) is atmospheric glow only, never a fill, border, or text color.
Don't add heavy drop shadows or hard elevation steps to cards; depth is light, not weight.
Don't ship a bright/white surface or a clinical dashboard grid of equal-weight cards — that is the explicit anti-reference.
Don't hyphenate or break headings across a word; keep whole words intact.
Don't substitute typefaces across tiers (no body copy in Syne, no headings in Bebas).
Don't duplicate the Ti Roulé chat per page — it is mounted once, globally.
